name: Czan UI and UI root function map
scope: CSelMode / CSelect Czan UI object creation, animation, draw traversal, and UI-root resource setup
notes: This file mirrors the exported .c/.h function names so confirmed Ghidra discoveries are not only stored in prose docs.
Many functions are currently exported as host stubs with confirmed parameter/field documentation, not full behavior.
Offsets are RAM addresses from main_DDRII.dol unless stated otherwise.

params.name: linkManager
params.role: CzanLinkManager object or stack storage, passed in r3

params.name: linkData
params.role: WII/link resource passed through to CzanLinkManager_SetLink in r4

confirmed_behavior: Sets the CzanLinkManager vtable at +0x10 to PTR_PTR_802C0790.
Calls CzanLinkManager_SetLink(linkManager, linkData) immediately after setting the vtable.
Listing confirms r3 is preserved as linkManager and incoming r4 is passed through as linkData.
Returns linkManager.

params.name: releaseMode
params.role: positive values release/free the manager through MemoryPool_Free

confirmed_behavior: Returns linkManager.
If linkManager is nonzero and releaseMode > 0, calls MemoryPool_Free(0, linkManager).
Common stack cleanup calls pass -1, so no allocator release happens in those cases.
functions.pseudocode: if (linkManager != 0 && releaseMode > 0) MemoryPool_Free(0, linkManager); return linkManager;

confirmed_behavior: Locks the mutex at DAT_802EE174 + poolIndex * 0x34.

Unlocks the mutex at DAT_802EE174 + poolIndex * 0x34.
Creates Czan object groups from WII blocks 0..3 into uiRootManager[1..4].
Allocates/initializes sub-managers from blocks 4..8.
Creates five standalone TPL textures from blocks 9..13 into uiRootManager[5..9].
Sets uiRootManager[0] = 1 when setup completes.

params.name: referenceObjectGroupHandle
params.role: Czan object group containing the reference child, or -1 when no reference child is used

params.name: referenceChildIndex
params.role: child index in the reference object group; -1 skips linking/copying reference data

confirmed_behavior: Returns -1 if uiRootManager[1] is -1.
Otherwise creates/clones a Czan object group with CzanUiManager_CloneObjectGroup(global Czan UI manager, uiRootManager[1], 2, 0).
If referenceChildIndex is not -1, links the new group to referenceObjectGroupHandle/referenceChildIndex using linkMode.
If the new group is valid, fetches the reference child object with FUN_80175804 and applies referenceObject - 8 to the new group with FUN_8017559C.
Reads reference child color/settings through FUN_801761E0 and applies those bytes to the new group with FUN_80175B00.
Enables the reference child through CzanUiManager_SetChildObjectEnabled(..., 1).
Returns the new group handle.

confirmed_behavior: Finds the first free object-group slot whose child handle array at group +0x20 is zero.
Returns -1 if no free slot is available.
Copies the source group's descriptor pointer at +0x1C and child count from descriptor +0x08.
Allocates a new child handle array sized childCount * 4 and stores it at newGroup +0x20.
Initializes group bounds/scale fields at +0x0C, +0x10, +0x14, and +0x18.
For every source child descriptor, allocates a 0x1D8-byte CzanSpriteObject and a 0x1B4-byte CzanUiObjectInstance.
Descriptor type 2 creates an 8x8 dummy sprite with no texture.
Other descriptor types copy texture slot/resource fields from the matching source child sprite and bind the texture frame.
Stores each cloned object instance in the new group's child handle array.
Sets object +0x20 to the UI manager, object +0x24 to the cloned sprite, object +0x198 to the descriptor, object +0x16C to initialAnimIndex, and object +0x1A4 to the new group handle.
If cloneFlags low byte is 1 or 2, starts and runs the selected animation, then resets several animation state fields.
If cloneFlags low byte is 3 or 4, calls CzanUiObjectInstance_PreplayInitialAnimation; flag 4 also clears object +0xB0.
Descriptor flags at +0x1A control draw/enable/animation flags on the cloned object.
Marks the UI manager and new group as active and updates a group flag depending on whether any cloned child is drawable.
Returns the new object group handle.
